Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Anita - 60 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sonali - 30 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Kavita - 33 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rajesh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Rajesh: "I knew it!"

[Rajesh drinks a beer.]

Rajesh: "Careful!"

[Rajesh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Rajesh (happily): "What a day to remember!"
